reviews.review_text:
Leean W
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam206 contributions
0
A Gem in Phu My Hung
Jan 2021
We eat regularly in Saigon Craft and overall have had amongst the best tasting food in the city. The wines and beers are very good as well. Amongst our favourite dishes are the chicken nuggets and French Fries - the chicken nuggets have to be the best tasted anywhere, ever!!! The vegetable quesadillas are also the best tasting quesadillas that I have ever eaten and I eat quesadillas everywhere. The corn on the cob is always super tasty and plentiful and all of the food is served piping hot. The only disappointment has been the fried taco chips. Advertised as a vegetable dish we hadn't expected fish sauce to be poured over the fries prior to serving and as we have an aversion to fish sauce we were unable to eat them once we tasted the first few. The salad too was pleasant with a tasty dressing except that I would have preferred the dressing to be a standard French dressing without the raw herbs added to it. That said, such is the excellent taste of all other food eaten there, that I felt this restro bar thoroughly deserves a 5 star rating rather than 4 star. Final mention must be made of the staff who are super friendly, helpful and welcoming. This is a place that we now visit regularly and always eat as well as have a drink there.

A fantastic bar and grill in the centre of Phu My Hung - Amazing beers!
May 2018 • Friends
This is a great spot located in the centre of Phu My Hung, owned by expats who are welcoming and accomodating. 

There is a vast selection of craft beers, they have a fancy tap system unlike no other i have seen in Saigon. The selection of beers is incredible and to complement the drinks, they have a very nice menu for bar snacks and meals. Prices are very reasonable and the service was fantastic. 

The crowd is a mix, many Americans, Australians, English expats and quite a few Koreans and Vietnamese also, they cater for all tastes! 

Recently, they just started to provide bruch at the weekends, i had the best bacon sandwich last week since being in Vietnam for 10 years, proper bacon and decent bread!

Overall this is my favorite spot in Phu My Hung for a quiet beer and good food, location is close to the river so the air is clean when you sit outside

Best beer pub in D7
May 2018 • Solo
Like someone else said, it's good not to have to go do D7 to enjoy cool crafted beers, inside or al fresco. Their selection is pretty wide and good. A bit of every local brewer, indeed.
I tried the food once. What I preferred was the baked potato.
Skewers, a bit burned for me.
I also had the green salad. Well, I was surprised by the portion size, huge! But there are ingredients that shouldn't be there, and others missing.
Please, don't put dill. It's way too strong for a salad. Parsley better matches.
And you should replace carrots with tomatoes. Carrots in a salad, never seen!?!?
The brunch looks quite interesting, no I'll certainly try it soon :)
